stem_book: Find the value of p, q, r …… which represent real number. (i) Find the nth term of AGP series 1/4 + 3/16 + 5/64 + 7/256 + …….. is (pn − q)/r^(n). (ii) Find the sum to n term of the series 1/(1+1²+1⁴) + 2/(1+2²+2⁴) + 3/(1+3²+3⁴) + …. is (n^(p) + n)/[q(n² + n + r)]. (iii) Find the sum to n term of the series 1/2 + 2/4 + 3/8 + 4/16 + 5/32 + …… is (p^(n+1) + q − n)/r^(n). [Give p, q, r for each.]
reason: Three-part recap, each part with its own triple (p,q,r); manifest split it into 3 entries sharing one code. All three key values are correct.
work: (i) Tn=(2n−1)/4^n; (ii) k/(k⁴+k²+1) = (1/2)[1/(k²−k+1) − 1/(k²+k+1)] telescopes to (n²+n)/(2(n²+n+1)); (iii) Σk/2^k = (2^(n+1) − 2 − n)/2^n (checked exactly n=1..8)
